newsitem.title: USA: Air Products stresses productivity gains.
newsitem.headline: Air Products stresses productivity gains.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Thursday it is emphasizing productivity gains and "sustainable, top-line growth" as it moves forward.
In the third quarter, Air Products said operating margins improved across the company, led by a gases margin of 20.5 percent.
The company reported earnings per share of $1.05 compared with $0.87 for the same period a year ago.
Its industrial gas sales rose 18 percent and operating income increased 38 percent. The merchant business was up in both the U.S. and Europe.
Gas equity affiliate results were below last year, partially due to the consolidation of Carburos Metalicos.
Volume gains were recorded across most businesses, but were partially offset by customer turnarounds.
In the corporate and other segment, foreign exchange losses versus prior period gains were the principal cause of lower results, it said.
The quarter's results also reflected higher interest expense for the Carburos Metalicos acquisition, new capital investments brought onstream and its continuing share repurchase program.
